GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading aloud.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading aloud.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading aloud.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading aloud.

2. When practising Listening for information, Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information, Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information, Interactive Speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information, Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information, Interactive Speaking.

3. When practising Active Listening, Oral Expressions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening, Oral Expressions.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening, Oral Expressions.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening, Oral Expressions.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening, Oral Expressions.

4. When practising Listening for information, Interactive speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information, Interactive speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information, Interactive speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information, Interactive speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information, Interactive speaking.

5. When practising Active Listening, Oral expressions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening, Oral expressions.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening, Oral expressions.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening, Oral expressions.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening, Oral expressions.

6. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Wasser
   B. Buch
   C. Haus
   D. Schule

7. When practising Active listening, Oral expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Active listening, Oral expression.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Active listening, Oral expression.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Active listening, Oral expression.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active listening, Oral expression.

8. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Good night
   B. Please
   C. Good day / hello
   D. Thank you
